::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
ST's India centre in Noida is one of its major design hubs, with significant work on STM32 microcontroller family and MEMS sensor design.
:::

## What does this firm design?

STM32 microcontrollers, MEMS inertial sensors and microphones, power management ICs, and SiC power devices.
